entries.readingTip: Counting uses イチ; "one thing" is ひとつ and "one person" is ひとり.

mnemonic.text: One finger laid flat: a single line means one.
Two fingers laid flat, the bottom one a little longer: two.

lookAlikes.note: 三 three has three lines

mnemonic.text: Three lines stacked like three fingers held sideways: three.

lookAlikes.note: 二 two has two lines

entries.readingTip: Say よん in most numbers (四十 よんじゅう); し appears in 四月 しがつ.

mnemonic.text: A box with legs inside: four walls holding a pair of legs. Think of a four-poster bed.

lookAlikes.note: 西 west has a lid sticking out

mnemonic.text: Two lines with a zigzag between them, like a crooked 5 lying on a shelf: five.
A little hat on top and two legs below: six is a person in a hat doing the splits.

entries.readingTip: Both しち and なな are used; なな is clearer on the phone.

mnemonic.text: An upside-down 7 with a line through it: seven.
Two strokes spreading apart like the bottom of a skirt or a mountain path: eight.

lookAlikes.note: 人 person: the strokes join at the top

entries.readingTip: キュウ in most numbers; ク in 九月 くがつ.

mnemonic.text: An arm reaching out with a hooked elbow: nine looks like a strong arm flexing.
A cross: count to ten on your fingers and cross them.
One (一) on top of white (白): one white sheet holds a hundred grains of rice.

lookAlikes.note: 白 has no top line

mnemonic.text: Ten (十) with a slash on top: a thousand is ten with a stroke of extra effort.

lookAlikes.note: 午 noon has a flat top line
十 ten has no slash

vocab.meaning: arrival in Japan; coming to Japan

entries.readingTip: Alone it is ひ (day) or び in 日曜日; in compounds it is usually ニチ.

mnemonic.text: A window with one bar: you see the sun through it every day.

lookAlikes.note: 目 eye has two inner lines
白 white has a tick on top

entries.readingTip: Months of the year use ガツ (一月 いちがつ); "this month" uses ゲツ; the moon itself is つき.

mnemonic.text: A crescent moon leaning to the side with two clouds across it.
A person (人) with sparks flying out on both sides: fire.
A central stream with splashes flicking off left and right: water.

lookAlikes.note: 氷 ice (N3) adds a dot

mnemonic.text: A trunk with one branch across and two roots spreading below: a tree.

lookAlikes.note: 本 book adds a line at the root
休 rest adds a person

vocab.meaning: large amount of money; great cost

mnemonic.text: A roof over a mine shaft, with two gold nuggets glinting in the earth.
A small cross planted on a long line of ground: soil.

lookAlikes.note: 士 samurai has a longer top line

mnemonic.text: Three peaks, the middle one tallest: a mountain.

vocab.meaning: upper reaches of a river; upstream

mnemonic.text: Three lines of water running side by side: a river.
A person standing with arms out (大) under one line: the sky above everyone.

lookAlikes.note: 大 big has no top line

mnemonic.text: Steam rising in wavy lines over a pot, with an X of energy inside: spirit and air.

lookAlikes.note: 汽 steam (N3) adds water

mnemonic.text: A window or sky frame with raindrops falling inside: rain.

entries.readingTip: Nationalities use ジン (日本人); counting people uses ニン (三人); alone it is ひと.

mnemonic.text: Two legs walking: a person.

lookAlikes.note: 入 enter: the right stroke starts higher
八 eight: the strokes do not touch

mnemonic.text: A baby wrapped up with arms reaching out: child.

lookAlikes.note: 字 character adds a roof
学 study adds sparks and a cover

vocab.meaning: men and women; man and woman

mnemonic.text: A woman kneeling with crossed legs and arms gracefully folded.

vocab.meaning: men and women; man and woman

mnemonic.text: A rice field (田) above power (力): the man works in the field.

lookAlikes.note: 田 field on its own

mnemonic.text: Two crossed tools under a pair of marks: father with his tools crossed, ready to work.
A woman shape with two dots for a mother nursing her baby.

lookAlikes.note: 毎 every adds a hat

entries.readingTip: ダイ in 大学; タイ in 大会; おお- in words like 大きい.

mnemonic.text: A person (人) stretching their arms wide: big!

lookAlikes.note: 天 sky adds a line on top
犬 dog adds a dot

mnemonic.text: A small hook with a dot on each side: tiny bits scattering, small.
A line straight through the middle of a box: middle, inside.

vocab.meaning: top and bottom; high and low

entries.readingTip: うえ "above"; あ(がる) "go up"; ジョウ in compounds like 上手.

mnemonic.text: A line pointing up from the ground: above, up.

lookAlikes.note: 下 down points the other way

vocab.meaning: top and bottom; high and low

entries.readingTip: した "below"; さ(げる)/くだ(る) for lowering or going down; カ/ゲ in compounds.

mnemonic.text: A line hanging down from the ceiling: below, down.

lookAlikes.note: 上 up points the other way

vocab.meaning: left and right; right and left

mnemonic.text: A hand reaching over a mouth (口): you eat with your right hand.

lookAlikes.note: 石 stone (N3)
左 left has 工 instead of 口

vocab.meaning: left and right; right and left

mnemonic.text: A hand holding a carpenter's square (工): the left hand holds the tool.

lookAlikes.note: 右 right has 口 instead of 工

mnemonic.text: The sun (日) rising behind a tree (木): east, where the sun comes up.

lookAlikes.note: 車 car has no slanting legs

mnemonic.text: A bird settling into its nest at sunset: west.

lookAlikes.note: 四 four has legs inside a box

vocab.meaning: north and south; north to south

mnemonic.text: A tent with a cross on top and a warm fire below: south, where it is warm.

vocab.meaning: north and south; north to south

mnemonic.text: Two people sitting back to back, turning away from the cold north wind.
Evening (夕) plus a fortune-telling stick (卜): going outside at night to read the stars.

lookAlikes.note: 夕 evening on its own

vocab.meaning: the preceding year; the previous year

mnemonic.text: A person carrying a big bundle of rice: a year's harvest.
The sun (日) beside a temple (寺): the temple bell tells the time.
The sun (日) shining through a gate (門): the space between the doors.

lookAlikes.note: 聞 hear has an ear (耳)
問 question has a mouth (口)

vocab.meaning: in the morning; during the morning

mnemonic.text: A cow (牛) without its horn sticking up: noon, when even the cow rests.

lookAlikes.note: 牛 cow pokes through the top
千 thousand has a slash, not a line

vocab.meaning: the preceding year; the previous year

mnemonic.text: Horns on top, flesh (月) and a knife (刂): the butcher works in front of you.

entries.readingTip: ゴ in 午後; うし(ろ) "behind"; あと "after".

mnemonic.text: Small steps (彳) and a thread with a slow foot: walking behind, after.
A roof over a single line: right now, under this roof.

lookAlikes.note: 会 meet adds 云 below

mnemonic.text: A person wearing a hat over mother (母): every mother, every day.

lookAlikes.note: 母 mother has no hat

mnemonic.text: Two horns on top and a cross cut in half: half.

entries.readingTip: なに before most sounds; なん before d, n and t sounds and counters (何時 なんじ).

mnemonic.text: A person (亻) next to "can" (可): what can a person do?

lookAlikes.note: 可 can has no person

mnemonic.text: One (一) over a hook like a pen flourish: ten thousand.

lookAlikes.note: 方 direction has a dot on top
力 power has no top line

vocab.meaning: appreciation of the yen; strong yen

mnemonic.text: A round window frame: a circle, and the round yen coin.

entries.readingTip: い(く) "go" is the one to learn first; ギョウ is "a line of text", コウ appears in 銀行.

mnemonic.text: A crossroads split in two (彳 + 亍): go along the road.

vocab.meaning: arrival in Japan; coming to Japan
to be able to do; to be up to the task

mnemonic.text: A tree (木) with rice grains blowing in: next year's rice is coming.

vocab.meaning: to take out; to get out

mnemonic.text: Two mountains (山) stacked: climb out over the peaks.

vocab.meaning: going in and out; entering and exiting

mnemonic.text: A person (人) leaning forward to enter through a doorway.

lookAlikes.note: 人 person: the left stroke starts higher

vocab.meaning: to be absent; to take a day off
to be rested; to feel at ease

mnemonic.text: A person (亻) leaning against a tree (木): rest.

lookAlikes.note: 体 body has 本, not 木

vocab.meaning: in a train; on a train

mnemonic.text: A cart seen from above: wheel, axle and body. Car.

lookAlikes.note: 東 east has slanting legs

mnemonic.text: A child (子) under a roof with sparks of ideas above: study.

lookAlikes.note: 字 character has a plain roof

mnemonic.text: A tree (木) beside people mixing (交): school under the trees.

vocab.meaning: the other day; a few days ago

mnemonic.text: A person with legs (儿) walking out in front: ahead, previous.

lookAlikes.note: 生 life has no legs

entries.readingTip: This kanji has many readings: セイ in 学生, う(まれる) "be born", い(きる) "live", なま "raw".

mnemonic.text: A plant sprouting from the earth: life, to be born.

lookAlikes.note: 先 ahead ends with legs (儿)

mnemonic.text: Two hands reaching across to each other: friend.
Evening (夕) and a mouth (口): in the dark you call out your name.

lookAlikes.note: 各 each (N3)

vocab.meaning: to be found; to be discovered

mnemonic.text: An eye (目) on legs (儿): going to see.

lookAlikes.note: 貝 shell has short legs

vocab.meaning: to be heard; to be audible
to listen attentively to; to be lost in
to get information out of a person

mnemonic.text: An ear (耳) at a gate (門): listening at the door.

lookAlikes.note: 間 space has the sun (日)
問 question has a mouth (口)

mnemonic.text: Words (言) and a tongue (舌): talking.

lookAlikes.note: 語 language has 吾 on the right
読 read has 売 on the right

vocab.meaning: to talk about; to speak of

mnemonic.text: Words (言) and "I" (吾): the words I speak, a language.

lookAlikes.note: 話 talk has 舌 on the right

mnemonic.text: Words (言) and sell (売): a seller reading out the words.

lookAlikes.note: 話 talk has 舌 on the right

mnemonic.text: A hand holding a brush (聿) over the sun (日): writing all day.
A jewel (玉) inside borders (囗): a country's treasure.
A tree (木) with a line at the root: the origin, and books made from trees.

lookAlikes.note: 木 tree has no root line

mnemonic.text: Long flowing hair: long.

vocab.meaning: appreciation of the yen; strong yen

mnemonic.text: A tall tower with a roof, a window and a door: tall, expensive.
The sun (日) with a ray shining on top: white light.

lookAlikes.note: 日 sun has no tick on top
百 adds a line on top

mnemonic.text: Rain (雨) above a field with a lightning tail: electricity.

vocab.meaning: bread; bread in a rectangular shape

mnemonic.text: A roof (人) over good food: eat.
